categories.main_business_segments: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic ceramic components industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components and advanced materials. Its main products include communication components, electronic components and materials, and new materials, serving sectors such as electronics, communications, consumer electronics, industrial electronic equipment, and new energy. The company also develops products for emerging fields like AI, data centers, automotive electronics, and bioceramics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 50 years of R&D experience in electronic ceramic components, mastering ceramic material preparation, forming, sintering technologies, and precision mold design. It has achieved large-scale production of key products like MLCCs (multi-layer ceramic capacitors) and ceramic inserts. The firm emphasizes continuous innovation in materials, manufacturing processes, and automation, including breakthroughs in high-capacity MLCCs, solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC), and bioceramic components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, optical communications, semiconductor, AI, robotics, and new energy sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying components for mobile terminals, data centers, industrial control, and medical devices. Major customers are diversified, with the top five accounting for approximately 13.79% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangdong Province and multiple subsidiaries across regions including Shenzhen, Chengdu, Suzhou, Deyang, and Nanchong. It also has overseas subsidiaries and operations in Germany, the Netherlands, the United States, Malaysia, South Korea, India, Thailand, and Hong Kong, reflecting a broad international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chaozhou Three-Circle operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and development of electronic ceramic components and materials. It supplies these components to downstream manufacturers in electronics, communications, automotive, and other industries, positioning itself as a key component supplier rather than an end-product manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and scale expansion to strengthen its core product competitiveness and market position. R&D focuses include enhancing MLCC technology, developing high-capacity and automotive-grade MLCCs, advancing solid oxide fuel cells, bioceramics for medical applications, and precision ceramic components for semiconductors. It is expanding research centers in Chengdu and Suzhou and integrating AI technologies to improve information management and production automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electronic components and materials, including MLCCs, ceramic inserts, and advanced materials. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. Sales are conducted via direct product sales to industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading domestic player with strong R&D capabilities and a growing international footprint in the electronic ceramic components industry. It emphasizes technological breakthroughs and product diversification to maintain competitive advantages amid increasing industry competition and import substitution trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.37 billion, a 28.78% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.19 billion, up 38.55%. It maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment (7.91% of revenue) and expanding production capacity. Total assets reached nearly RMB 24 billion, reflecting steady scale expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chaozhou Three-Circle emphasizes its deep technological expertise, comprehensive product matrix, and innovation-driven development as key differentiators. Its ability to produce high-capacity, automotive-grade, and diversified MLCC products, along with advanced ceramic materials for emerging industries like bioceramics and fuel cells, provides unique value. The company also highlights its strong customer service, quality assurance, and commitment to sustainable, high-quality growth.
